title: Sibling Bloodline Resonance
next_chapter_hook: Just when Chen Ji thought everything had settled, the voice of Mo Xiansheng, the soul guardian deep within the Tianji Record, suddenly rang out: 'You think you've won? No... you've only just stepped into the entrance of the chess game.'

text.content: Deep within the Mental Sea, Chen Ji's consciousness was like a candle in the wind, already flickering toward extinction, yet at the last moment was reconstituted by a scorching force. On the Fragment, the long-dormant pattern was slowly lighting up, as if something was awakening.

Just as consciousness was about to completely dissolve, a warm force suddenly surged from his chest, rushing along the bloodline straight into the Mental Sea. Chen Ji opened his eyes abruptly—he felt it, the call of the bloodline, a call from afar.

The voice was cold as ice, yet carried the warmth of bloodline connection. The dragon pattern on Chen Ji's chest suddenly burst into dazzling light, an unprecedented power surging through his bloodline. He saw a blurred figure in the chaos—Chen Nian, standing in some dark corner, straining to maintain this bloodline pathway with all her strength.

dialogue.content: What is this! How can you possess such pure bloodline power!

text.content: Ling Yuan's face contorted in that instant, his eyes filled with disbelief. He was an Nascent Soul realm old monster, personally watching Chen Ji being crushed into a dead dog by his own pressure, yet now that waste's body was surging with bloodline fluctuations even he couldn't ignore.

choice.prompt: Bloodline power awakening, Chen Ji faces a choice: to bear the breakthrough's pressure alone, or accept his sister's shared power?

choices.description: Completely transform bloodline power into combat strength, independently strike at the Nascent Soul threshold, endure all backlash
choices.visible_cost: Consumes massive Heavenly Fate, may cause unstable foundation
choices.visible_reward: Display pure combat strength, let everyone witness thetrash's reversal
choices.risk_hint: Extremely high risk, but most direct reward

text.content: Chen Ji gritted his teeth and absorbed all the bloodline power into his body. The Tianji Recordcrazed rotated in his Mental Sea, the patterns on the Fragment spreading visibly. His aura surged instantly, directly breaking through the Foundation Building peak shackles.

choices.description: Establish complete bloodline resonance with Chen Nian, jointly bear breakthrough backlash, significantly reduce consumption
choices.visible_cost: Need to give half the breakthrough power to Chen Nian
choices.visible_reward: Unlock nascent 'Shared Destiny', greatly reduce Heavenly Fate consumption, and establish deep connection with sister
choices.risk_hint: Relatively safe, and can obtain additional strategic advantages

text.content: Chen Ji did not devour this power alone, but actively opened the bloodline pathway, incorporating Chen Nian's power into his body. The two bloodlines intertwined and resonated, and new patterns suddenly emerged on the Tianji Record Fragment.

choices.memory_label: 首次成功与妹妹建立血脉共鸣

text.content: The Tianji Record发出一声清鸣 in the Mental Sea, the patterns on the Fragment spreading like spring water breaking through ice. Chen Ji's auracrazed攀升, Foundation Building peak, False Core realm, until he touched that legendary threshold—Nascent Soul!

dialogue.content: Impossible! You're merely Foundation Building trash, how could you touch the Nascent Soul gate!

text.content: Ling Yuan's voice trembled. He had lived for centuries and never witnessed such absurdity. A servant disciple deemedtrash by the entire sect had, at the moment of life and death, accomplished a breakthrough he had failed to achieve despite a hundred years of bitter cultivation. Though only a brief touch, that was indeed the aura suppression unique to Nascent Soul realm.

dialogue.content: Old thing, what did you just say? trash?

text.content: Chen Ji slowly rose to his feet, bones throughout his body发出炒豆般的脆响. He felt the surging power within, the Tianji Record Fragment散发着温热的光辉 in his Mental Sea. At this moment, he didn't rush to attack, but instead fixed his gaze on a talisman on the cuff of Ling Yuan's sleeve.

That was a talisman extremely familiar to Chen Ji—the Holy Sect's communication talisman. He had seen similar things during that great battle, when Ye Qing's Holy Sect mark was identical to this talisman. The Tianqing Sect's old patriarch was secretly colluding with the demonic Holy Sect?

choice.prompt: Chen Ji discovered Ling Yuan's secret with the Holy Sect, how should he handle this information?

choices.description: Point out Ling Yuan's relationship with the Holy Sect in front of him, completely exposing this scandal
choices.visible_cost: May cause sect turmoil, Ling Yuan may act desperately
choices.visible_reward: Thoroughly destroy Ling Yuan's reputation, let the entire Tianqing Sect witness his true colors

text.content: Chen Ji waved his hand, a strand of Spiritual Light directly shattering the talisman on Ling Yuan's sleeve. As the talisman exploded, a mournful scream emerged from within—that was the fear of a Holy Sect member being exposed.

choices.description: Don't make it public, but use this secret as leverage against Ling Yuan in the future
choices.visible_cost: Cannot immediately obtain the satisfaction of exposure
choices.visible_reward: Gain a key trump card for use at crucial moments in the future
choices.risk_hint: Relatively safe, with delayed but massive returns

text.content: Chen Ji收回目光, lips curling into a subtle smile. He had firmly recorded this scene—Ling Yuan's relationship with the Holy Sect would be useful in the future.

However, Chen Ji's target was not on Ling Yuan. He felt the information Chen Nian transmitted through the bloodline pathway, his heart掀起惊涛骇浪. She had discovered a shocking secret within the Holy Sect—her existence was not merely 'Heavenly Fate Lock Key', but also the key to interfering with the Tianji Record's foresight ability.

dialogue.content: Brother, I understand now. My bloodline can interfere with Tianji Record's foresight—where I am, you cannot see the future clearly. This is not a flaw, but our Chen family's talent!

text.content: Chen Ji instantly understood the profound meaning. The Tianji Record allowed him to foresee three hours ahead, yet any prophecy involving Chen Nian resulted in blurred visions. What did this mean? It meant as long as Chen Nian was by his side, no one could spy on their plans through the Tianji Record or similar abilities.

This was a perfect complement—the Tianji Record's foresight combined with Chen Nian's interference ability, becoming the strongest combination in the world. And at this moment, Chen Nian in the distant Holy Sect was transmitting this understanding to Chen Ji through the bloodline, their souls unprecedentedly tightly connected at this moment.

choice.prompt: After successful bloodline resonance, Chen Ji must make a final decision: how to deal with Ling Yuan?

choices.description: While Ling Yuan is weak,彻底击杀 him, eliminate future troubles
choices.visible_cost: May cause sect turmoil, and will expose true strength
choices.visible_reward: Completely eliminate a sworn enemy, and can seize Ling Yuan's cultivation resources
choices.risk_hint: Extremely high risk, but eliminates all future troubles permanently

text.content: A cold light flashed in Chen Ji's eyes as he raised his hand, sending a fierce sword qi. However, just as the sword qi was about to touch Ling Yuan, a strange force deflected his attack.

choices.description: Don't kill Ling Yuan, use him as a chess piece, let enemies see thetrash的 'mercy' and lower their guard
choices.visible_cost: Ling Yuan will inevitably seek revenge in the future, requiring constant vigilance
choices.visible_reward: Maintaintrash人设, and continue using Ling Yuan's identity for maneuvering
choices.risk_hint: Relatively safe, with satisfaction coming from the pleasure of playing the pig to eat the tiger

text.content: Chen Ji retracted the sword qi, coldly gazing at Ling Yuan: 'Old thing, today I won't kill you. Not because I can't, but because you're not worth it. Go back and tell the Holy Sect people, I've seen all their little tricks.'

Ling Yuan clutched his chest, face full of humiliation and fear. He wanted to say something, yet discovered he was pinned in place by atrash's pressure, unable to move. This feeling was worse than death.

dialogue.content: Chen Ji... wait for me! Today's humiliation, I will repay a hundredfold!

text.content: Ling Yuan's figure stumbled away after the pressure dissipated. That once invincible Nascent Soul old monster was now as disheveled as an injured old dog. Chen Ji did not pursue. He simply stood quietly in place, feeling the warmth transmitted by Chen Nian through the bloodline pathway.

dialogue.content: Brother, we succeeded. Do you feel it? This is our bond.

text.content: Chen Ji gently closed his eyes. Yes, he felt it. That was the warmth of bloodline connection, the bond finally reconnected after years of separation. The Tianji Record slowly turned in his Mental Sea, the patterns on the Fragment brighter than ever before, as if responding to this recovered kinship.

dialogue.content: Brother, I discovered our bloodline's secret. The Tianji Record holder and the Heavenly Fate Lock Key are two sides of the same coin. My existence is to protect you.

text.content: Chen Ji's body trembled slightly. Heavenly Fate Lock Key and Tianji Record holder, two sides of the same coin. He finally understood why Chen Nian was taken by the Holy Sect, why her existence could interfere with Tianji Record's foresight. None of this was coincidence from the beginning.

At this moment, the voice of Mo Xiansheng, the long-dormant soul guardian deep within the Tianji Record, suddenly rang out: 'You've finally reached this step. Bloodline resonance is complete, the chess game officially begins.' That voice was calm yet carried an undetectable trace of relief, 'Remember, the Heavenly Fate Lock Key and the Tianji Record holder, neither can be lacking. Your sister's existence is your greatest weakness, and also your strongest backing.'
